conjectures.statement: For any smooth solution of 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes, positive viscous logarithmic growth along material lines is bounded by V_log^+ <= nu * max(0, Delta(|omega|)) / |omega|, and vanishes identically at all local spatial maxima of |omega|.
conjectures.proof_sketch: Follows from xi . Delta(omega) = Delta(q) - q * ||grad(xi)||_F^2 and ||grad(xi)||_F^2 >= 0.
